claim: There is no root workspaces field; each package self-installs.
check: test ! -f package.json; git grep -l '"workspaces"' -- '**/package.json' | grep -v node_modules || true

claim: There are no cross-package imports except the CLI resolving native helpers by relative path.
Every agent invocation goes through one path: buildExecEnv then execAgent / runWithFallback in apps/cli/src/lib/exec.ts, entered via agents run.
apps/cli owns session/team/run/cloud/SSH state; apps/ext is a consumer of CLI JSON, not a second mechanism.
Fleet-affecting features have exactly one scheduler and one executor: the agents-cli daemon or a CLI command it drives. UI surfaces must not own a timer/watcher/loop that acts.
DotAgents resources are one kind per subdirectory: rules, commands, skills, hooks, mcp, permissions, profiles, subagents.
AGENTS.md is canonical; CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md are symlinks to it.
check: ls -l AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md GEMINI.md apps/cli/AGENTS.md apps/cli/CLAUDE.md apps/cli/GEMINI.md

claim: supports() in capabilities.ts is the only place that decides whether an agent+version can receive a resource.
check: rg -n 'export function supports\b' apps/cli/src/lib/capabilities.ts; rg -n 'supports\(' apps/cli/src --glob '!**/*.test.ts' | wc -l

claim: Legacy layouts fold once in installations/migrate.ts; downstream code assumes the post-fold layout.
check: test -f apps/cli/src/lib/installations/migrate.ts && test ! -f apps/cli/src/lib/migrate.ts; rg -n 'runMigration\(' apps/cli/src --glob '!**/*.test.ts'

claim: The old mcp__Swarm__* surface was folded into teams; don't reach for Swarm.
isSelfUpdatingAgent() is the single predicate for harnesses with no pinnable semver; do not scatter === 'droid' checks.
check: rg -n 'export function isSelfUpdatingAgent\b' apps/cli/src/lib/agents.ts; rg -n "=== ['\"]droid['\"]|=== ['\"]grok['\"]" apps/cli/src --glob '!**/*.test.ts' | wc -l

claim: Three diagnostics with distinct scopes: agents fleet status (devices), agents inspect (one harness), agents doctor (umbrella).
Source layout documents versions.ts, shims.ts, migrate.ts, computer-rpc.ts, ssh-tunnel.ts at src/lib/ root.
check: ls -1 apps/cli/src/lib/versions.ts apps/cli/src/lib/shims.ts apps/cli/src/lib/migrate.ts apps/cli/src/lib/computer-rpc.ts apps/cli/src/lib/ssh-tunnel.ts 2>&1

claim: Teams and run share code through the agents run command line (buildRunArgv), not a shared in-process function.
Account state is daemon-owned: one account-state-service per state directory; readers only render published files.
Live identity has two pid-to-id writers: CLI terminals/by-pid (CLI reads) and session-tracker terminals/sessions (extension reads).
check: rg -n 'writePidSessionEntry|by-pid' apps/cli/src/lib/session --glob '!**/*.test.ts' | head -20; rg -n 'terminals/sessions|STATE_DIR' packages/session-tracker --glob '!**/*.test.ts' | head -20; rg -n 'liveSession|terminals/sessions' apps/ext/src --glob '!**/*.test.ts' | head -20

claim: src/lib/session/ is the transcript reader; the live-session writer is packages/session-tracker.
Hooks live in a single layered hooks.yaml; system + user merged, user wins on same name.
